description: "Undelete and Disable References" on DLCRobot.esm with every option of the Cleaning tab away from its default: no player enable parent (UDRSetXESP off), a scale of 0.5 (UDRSetScale on), and a height of -20000 for the references that are not persistent. The scale goes to the XSCL element the reference gets, or (an upstream quirk) to the element the step found last when the reference has one.
